To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Tennessee Eastman distillation column can be controlled with only 5 manipulated variables and that the best choice is to control the distillation column bottom composition, distillate flow rate, reflux rate and two temperatures.

the Tennessee Eastman plant is self-optimizing with respect to the following controlled variables: the flow of component A to the first reactor, the flow of component B to the first reactor (the flow of component C to the first reactor is the same as the flow of component D to the first reactor), the flow of component C from the third reactor, the flow and the temperature of component D from the second reactor.
